verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy is a SaaS commerce platform with webhooks, segments and email features, so asking whether its automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows that capability. The API major-version policy (docs-3) is about API compatibility, and test mode (docs-1) is a testing environment; both are adjacent features, not versioning or rollback of user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
